title: No paper receipt? Get it from Costco as a PDF

vo.text: Lost your Costco receipt? Save it as a PDF.
On iPhone, use the Costco app. On Android, use costco.ca in your browser.
Tap Account, then Orders and Purchases.
Open the warehouse tab, and view the receipt.
Tap Print Receipt, then save it as a PDF.
In PriceBack, tap Upload file, and pick the PDF.
